title: CPG builds had no corpus guardrail — whole-root builds on huge repos ground unbounded
evidence: Whole-root python build on monorepo: ~30k files, 52+ CPU-min, ~18.5GB RSS growing, single-threaded, had to be killed. Nothing in kz refused or warned before committing to the build.
repair: engine.rs: SourceCensus preflight (one walk feeds corpus size + newest mtime), BuildLimits with DEFAULT_MAX_SOURCE_FILES=25_000, build_and_save refuses over-cap with an actionable error naming targetSubdir/maxSourceFiles; fresh-artifact loads never limited; census surfaced as CpgBuildReport.source_files and in cpg:build labels/JSON; caps.max_cpg_source_files knob (ceiling 2M) on taint-iris-next + maxSourceFiles on cpg:build.

title: subtree-scoped CPG work wrote .kuzushi state inside the scanned subtree
evidence: ensure_project keyed artifacts on the scan root, so a targetSubdir hunt or subdir cpg:build against monorepo would have minted <subtree>/.kuzushi — polluting the live target's dirty set and tripping drift watch (contract forbids writing outside the root's git-ignored .kuzushi).
repair: BuildScope{whole,subtree} + scoped_artifact_path: subtree sources from root/subdir, artifact ALWAYS under <root>/.kuzushi/cpg-rs/scoped/<key>/; subtree() rejects absolute/'..'/empty; scoped graphs invisible to root readiness probes; cpgrs_build_scope(plan) maps scan_root vs repo_root; tests assert no .kuzushi in the subtree.

title: generated/vendored trees inflated the CPG corpus and staleness checks
evidence: bazel-*, gen/, generated/ and .kuzushi/ trees were walked for build, census, and freshness — wasted build time on machine-written code and made artifacts look stale when only generated output churned.
repair: languages.rs GENERATED_EXCLUDES ['/.kuzushi/','/bazel-','/gen/','/generated/'] appended via build_excludes(lang), applied uniformly to build, staleness census, and detection; test generated_trees_are_excluded_from_the_corpus.

title: scoped-hunt plumbing broke at the registry prepare boundary (3 defects found by live monorepo smoke)
evidence: (1) cpg:build subdir Path option lacked path semantics -> prepare refused every call; (2) workspace-read normalization hands subdir/targetSubdir back target-absolute, but BuildScope::subtree and the hunt adapter rejected absolute values -> scoped runs impossible via kuzushi run; (3) extraCatalogEntries was parsed by the hunt adapter but never declared as a descriptor option -> unknown-option rejection, operator boundary-anchored catalog entries unusable.
repair: subdir gets .workspace_read(); resolve_cpg_scope strips the target prefix from prepared absolute values; hunt adapter accepts absolute targetSubdir (containment still enforced at scan-root resolution, '..' still rejected); extraCatalogEntries declared as an advanced Json option on plan/hunt descriptors. Verified live: scoped scala cpg:build on monorepo forge subtree (192 files, 4.4s, artifact under .kuzushi/cpg-rs/scoped/, zero subtree writes, zero drift).

title: verify:finding agent loop was structurally unable to conclude on a large target (4 stacked bridge defects)
evidence: live monorepo verify runs died after ~19min sanitized to bridge_internal: (1) bridge never implemented toolPolicy.tools Read/Glob/Grep/LS so the verifier had zero file access; (2) langgraph recursionLimit default 25 halved the effective tool budget; (3) Vertex per-minute burst quota killed the loop mid-run (SDK fast retries cannot outlast a per-minute window); (4) verification_result_schema never asked the model for proofLevel/proofVerdict which verification_proof_snapshot requires without defaulting.
repair: commit f907e4a3: new scripts/langgraph-bridge/file-tools.mjs (sandboxed Read/LS/Glob/Grep gated by toolPolicy, mcpReadRoots containment, bounded output); QUERY_GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT=64; invokeThroughQuotaWindows (429 -> honor retry-after capped 300s else 65s, 3 windows) + MODEL_MAX_RETRIES=8; schema now requires proofLevel/proofVerdict with calibrated descriptions. cargo test -p kuzushi-core verification: 155 passed.

title: Prove attempt materialization failed for alias-launched verifies

repair: commit c5bc2f5b: both lookups switched to get_finding_by_operator_reference with rationale comments.

title: tool-budget exhaustion returned an opaque failure instead of a verdict

repair: local commit 91d11b95 (push pending on shared-box merge window): progress holder mirrors graph message state; on GraphRecursionError one final tool-free model call over gathered evidence (trailing AI message with unanswered tool_calls trimmed) forces a structured verdict with reduced confidence.

title: phase disposition 'selected' recorded even when materialization was blocked, dead-ending the attempt
evidence: pre-G24 binary recorded disposition=selected for F-0002 attempt f3cd95a5 although materialize_selected_proof_attempt failed -> the attempt can never be selected again; only recovery is rerunning verify to mint a new attempt. Journal phase-attempts.v2.jsonl keeps the poisoned row forever.
repair: disposition write must be sequenced strictly after materialization success (the selected_proof doc comment already demands caller-owned ordering — the TUI caller violates it); needs a repair + a recovery path for already-poisoned attempts.

title: batch triage summary overcounts: 'Triaged 6 of 6' while one finding's vote batch was rate_limited and never persisted
evidence: F-0004 triage votes died rate_limited; summary still claimed 6/6; findings list showed the finding untriaged. Recovered by rerunning batch triage without retriage (skips already-triaged).
repair: summary must count persisted triage rows, not dispatched batches; a failed batch should surface per-finding in the run summary.

title: vertex-anthropic runs always show 'cost not recorded' in Run Focus
evidence: every triage/verify/chain-hunt call on model=vertex-anthropic:* renders 'cost not recorded' — usage tokens are returned by the bridge but never priced for the vertex provider.
repair: price vertex usage via the same table as direct anthropic, or label the column n/a for unpriced providers instead of implying a bookkeeping failure.

title: TUI event-loop starvation delays keystrokes 30-120s during Run Focus
evidence: while an agent run streams, Navigate-mode keys (u/b/Esc) queue for 30-120s before taking effect; operator cannot tell whether the key registered — led to double-presses and ghost-autocomplete corruption of the composer.
repair: input handling must be decoupled from run-event ingestion (bounded channel + coalescing or a dedicated input thread).

title: findings list 'unverified' column lags behind persisted verifications until process restart
evidence: after 'u' materialized a proof (save_verification succeeded, export shows the verification block), the findings list still rendered 'unverified' for the finding until the TUI was restarted.
repair: invalidate/refresh the findings list cache on verification persistence events.

title: scoped-hunt findings render subdir-relative paths in list/export, ambiguous at review time
evidence: findings minted by a scoped hunt carry paths relative to the scan subtree, so the findings list and export show e.g. 'src/main/...' without the scoped prefix — the operator must remember which subtree the scan ran in to open the file.
repair: persist target-relative paths at finding creation (join scan-root prefix before persistence), not at render time.
